name: the hive
headline: A workspace made of *cells*
say: Here is what it looks like. Your work lives on a grid of cells, called tiles. A tile can hold anything: a picture, a note, a document, a game, a whole website. Open a tile and you travel into it, and every tile can open into a honeycomb of its own. What you are watching was recorded live: postcards from the mountains, the forest and the sea, each place a honeycomb of its own. Cells inside cells, all the way down.
